We had such a wonderful experience here! The mixed hot pot was absolutely delicious, with a great variety of fresh ingredients and a flavorful broth. Everything tasted fresh and was cooked perfectly. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a delicious and satisfying hot pot in Vietnam
